foundational.title: RT-1: Robotics Transformer for Real-World Control at Scale
foundational.why_ko: 로봇 13만 번의 시연을 학습해 수백 가지 일을 해내는 '큰 로봇 모델'의 출발점이에요.
foundational.why_en: Showed one Transformer trained on huge real-robot data can handle hundreds of tasks.

foundational.title: RT-2: Vision-Language-Action Models Transfer Web Knowledge to Robotic Control
foundational.why_ko: 인터넷 지식을 가진 AI가 로봇 동작까지 직접 출력하는 'VLA'라는 이름을 처음 붙인 논문이에요.
foundational.why_en: Coined 'VLA': a web-trained vision-language model that directly outputs robot actions.

foundational.title: OpenVLA: An Open-Source Vision-Language-Action Model
foundational.why_ko: 누구나 내려받아 쓰고 고칠 수 있게 공개된 VLA 모델로, 연구의 문턱을 낮췄어요.
foundational.why_en: A fully open VLA anyone can download and fine-tune, lowering the barrier to entry.

recent.title: GR00T N1: An Open Foundation Model for Generalist Humanoid Robots
recent.why_ko: 생각하는 '느린 뇌'와 움직이는 '빠른 뇌'를 합친, 휴머노이드용 공개 기반 모델이에요.
recent.why_en: Open humanoid foundation model pairing a slow 'thinking' system with a fast 'acting' system.

recent.title: π0.5: a Vision-Language-Action Model with Open-World Generalization
recent.why_ko: 처음 가 본 집에서도 부엌·침실 정리 같은 긴 집안일을 해낸 VLA예요.
recent.why_en: A VLA that cleans kitchens and bedrooms in homes it has never seen before.

recent.title: Gemini Robotics: Bringing AI into the Physical World
recent.why_ko: 거대 AI 모델 Gemini를 로봇의 눈·두뇌·손으로 확장한 구글 딥마인드의 대표 시스템이에요.
recent.why_en: Google DeepMind extends Gemini into a full robot brain for seeing, reasoning, and acting.

foundational.title: Code as Policies: Language Model Programs for Embodied Control
foundational.why_ko: LLM이 로봇 제어 코드를 직접 짜서 실행하게 한, '코드가 곧 정책'이라는 아이디어의 시작이에요.
foundational.why_en: Started the idea that an LLM can write the robot's control code itself.

foundational.title: ProgPrompt: Generating Situated Robot Task Plans using Large Language Models
foundational.why_ko: 작업 계획을 파이썬 프로그램 형태로 쓰게 해서, 주변 상황을 확인하며 실행하도록 했어요.
foundational.why_en: Prompts LLMs to write task plans as Python programs that check the scene while running.

foundational.title: Eureka: Human-Level Reward Design via Coding Large Language Models
foundational.why_ko: LLM이 '보상 코드(잘했다는 점수 규칙)'를 쓰고 학습 결과를 보며 고쳐, 사람보다 잘 설계했어요.
foundational.why_en: LLM writes reward code, reads training results, and revises it—beating human-designed rewards.

recent.title: CaP-X: A Framework for Benchmarking and Improving Coding Agents for Robot Manipulation
recent.why_ko: 코드를 쓰고, 실행 결과를 눈으로 비교하고, 다시 고치는 '코딩 에이전트' 로봇을 체계적으로 평가해요.
recent.why_en: Benchmarks robot coding agents that write code, watch results, and fix it over turns.

recent.title: HyCodePolicy: Hybrid Language Controllers for Multimodal Monitoring and Decision in Embodied Agents
recent.why_ko: 코드를 실행하는 동안 VLM이 화면을 지켜보다가 실패 원인을 찾아 코드를 스스로 고쳐요.
recent.why_en: A VLM watches code execution, explains failures, and the system repairs its own code.

recent.title: CodeDiffuser: Attention-Enhanced Diffusion Policy via VLM-Generated Code for Instruction Ambiguity
recent.why_ko: 애매한 지시를 VLM이 코드로 풀어 '어디를 볼지' 알려주고, 학습된 정책이 정교하게 움직여요.
recent.why_en: VLM-written code resolves vague instructions into attention maps that guide a learned policy.

foundational.title: Do As I Can, Not As I Say: Grounding Language in Robotic Affordances
foundational.why_ko: LLM의 계획에 '로봇이 지금 실제로 할 수 있는 일인지'를 함께 따져 고르게 한 SayCan이에요.
foundational.why_en: SayCan: LLM plans are filtered by what the robot can actually do right now.

foundational.title: Inner Monologue: Embodied Reasoning through Planning with Language Models
foundational.why_ko: 성공 여부·장면 설명·사람 말을 피드백으로 받아 로봇이 혼잣말하듯 계획을 다시 세워요.
foundational.why_en: Feeds success checks, scene descriptions, and human replies back so the LLM replans.

foundational.title: Robots That Ask For Help: Uncertainty Alignment for Large Language Model Planners
foundational.why_ko: 확신이 없을 때 통계적으로 판단해 사람에게 '도와주세요'라고 묻는 로봇이에요.
foundational.why_en: Robots measure their own uncertainty and ask humans for help when unsure.

recent.title: Hi Robot: Open-Ended Instruction Following with Hierarchical Vision-Language-Action Models
recent.why_ko: "그건 빼 줘" 같은 중간 끼어들기 말도 알아듣고, 상위 두뇌가 계획을 바로 고쳐요.
recent.why_en: A high-level VLM listens to mid-task feedback and re-plans for a low-level VLA.

recent.title: Being-0: A Humanoid Robotic Agent with Vision-Language Models and Modular Skills
recent.why_ko: 언어 계획 두뇌와 걷기·잡기 기술을 VLM이 이어 주어, 휴머노이드가 긴 일을 해내요.
recent.why_en: A humanoid agent where a VLM connects an LLM planner to walking and grasping skills.

recent.title: Gemini Robotics 1.5: Pushing the Frontier of Generalist Robots with Advanced Embodied Reasoning, Thinking, and Motion Transfer
recent.why_ko: 계획 담당 모델이 도구(검색 등)를 쓰며 여러 단계를 짜고, 행동 모델은 움직이기 전에 먼저 생각해요.
recent.why_en: A planner model orchestrates multi-step tasks with tools; the action model thinks before moving.

foundational.title: ViperGPT: Visual Inference via Python Execution for Reasoning
foundational.why_ko: 질문을 받으면 LLM이 이미지를 분석하는 파이썬 코드를 짜고 실행해서 답을 찾아요.
foundational.why_en: LLM answers visual questions by writing and running Python code over the image.

foundational.title: Visual Programming: Compositional visual reasoning without training
foundational.why_ko: 추가 학습 없이, 여러 시각 도구를 조합하는 짧은 프로그램으로 그림 문제를 풀어요.
foundational.why_en: Solves visual tasks by composing vision tools into short programs, with no extra training.

foundational.title: V*: Guided Visual Search as a Core Mechanism in Multimodal LLMs
foundational.why_ko: 큰 사진 속 작은 물체를, 사람처럼 '어디쯤 있을까' 추측하며 찾아가 다시 보게 했어요.
foundational.why_en: Lets a multimodal LLM search a large image step by step to find small details.

recent.title: DeepEyes: Incentivizing "Thinking with Images" via Reinforcement Learning
recent.why_ko: 강화학습으로, 모델이 생각하다 스스로 이미지를 확대(zoom)해 다시 보는 습관을 익혀요.
recent.why_en: Reinforcement learning teaches a VLM to zoom in and re-look while it reasons.

recent.title: Thyme: Think Beyond Images
recent.why_ko: 모델이 직접 코드를 써서 이미지를 자르고·돌리고·밝게 하며 계산까지 해요.
recent.why_en: A VLM writes and runs code to crop, rotate, enhance images, and compute.

recent.title: Vision in Action: Learning Active Perception from Human Demonstrations
recent.why_ko: 목(neck)을 움직이는 로봇이 사람 시연에서 '어디를 볼지' 배워, 가려진 것도 찾아 봐요.
recent.why_en: A robot with a movable neck learns from humans where to look during tasks.
